from pathlib import Path
flags=('--disable-gpu','--disable-gpu-compositing','--disable-software-rasterizer','--use-gl=disabled')
for p in sorted(Path('/proc').iterdir(), key=lambda x: int(x.name) if x.name.isdigit() else -1):
    if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
    try: argv=[x.decode('utf-8','replace') for x in (p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if x]
    except Exception: continue
    if not argv or argv[0] != '/opt/google/chrome/chrome': continue
    if '--app=http://127.0.0.1:8788/' in argv or '--user-data-dir=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/chrome-profile' in argv:
        print(p.name, ' '.join(argv)); print('FLAGS', [f for f in flags if f in argv])
